note: Prepared campaign definition; execution evidence is recorded separately. Exact unique production anchors; isolated snapshot setup precedes unchanged named semantic assertions. Evidence domains:22 emitted/public instruction-execution rows,1 public host-bank getter row,1 public decoder-frontier row,1 native owner/bridge PAE reload row. A failed build, trap, timeout or generic engine failure is never a semantic kill.
